item.description: This study utilized an Interpretive Phenomenological Approach (IPA) to examine how sequentially planned study abroad programs in Kenya and Nepal influenced pre-service teachers’ development of intercultural competence. item.description: Pre-service teacher preparation is a critical component in ensuring quality education for Students with Disabilities (SWDs), particularly during practicum training, which often serves as both a stage of professional growth and a source of psychological stress.
